738.title: Make the repository look professional to a recruiter

Card — the license: on the branch's repository page, the side panel shows «View license» (GitHub's label for a license it does not recognise), and opening it shows "All rights reserved" with your name.

Card — only when A3 could not take real screenshots: open the app at the slot's page, take the listed screenshots and drop them into `docs/images/` under the names A3 listed (the builder names them under Execution Notes).
